title: ADAS Sensor Calibrations: Cancelling a Calibration Order No Longer Needed
content:
An ADAS Sensor Calibrations order is cancelled, never declined, when its source no longer needs it:
- the source repair was withdrawn (**source withdrawn**);
- the source repair was declared a total loss (**source total loss**); or
- a customer-requested diagnosis found that no calibration is needed (**no calibration needed**), which carries the diagnostic charge of the tier's standalone diagnostic fee.

Cancellation is possible only before any attempt starts. Charges already posted for alignment work stay due.

## Reasons and their charges

| Cancellation reason | Charge carried by the cancellation | Alignment charges already posted |
|---|---|---|
| Source withdrawn | none | stay due |
| Source total loss | none | stay due |
| No calibration needed (customer-requested diagnosis) | diagnostic charge of the tier's standalone diagnostic fee | stay due |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical orders)

- An order in prechecked status, no attempt started, whose source repair was declared a total loss: cancellation is possible, with the reason source total loss.
- An order on which a calibration attempt has started: cancellation is no longer possible.
- An order cancelled as source withdrawn after an alignment check charge had been posted: the alignment check charge stays due.
